name: Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund small grants

funder.name: Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund

summary: Small grants for field conservation of individual threatened or poorly known animal, plant and fungus species anywhere in the world, reviewed in three funding rounds a year.
reporting: Grantees report on project progress through the Fund's website every six months and are expected to publish material about their work on the Fund's site.

eligibility.rule: Provide a correct conservation status or justify an incorrect one
If the project is ex situ, it is shown to be critical to the species' survival
For continuation funding, complete the prior project and submit all required reports by the deadline
Application in English, with budgets and financial data in US dollars

documents: Applicant's short biography or CV with a list of relevant publications
Recent annual report or other description of the organisation, if applicable
One JPEG image of the target species

deadline.quote: Applications submitted by 31st January 2027 will receive a response in late April 2027.
All applications submitted by 15th October 2026 will receive a response by the end of December 2026.

geography.quote: Its focus is global, and eligibility for grants extends to all plant, animal, and fungi conservation efforts, without discrimination based on region or species.

access.quote: Anyone directly involved in species conservation can apply to the Fund for a grant.

window.quote: We receive a large number of applications during each funding round in January, May and September / October.

amount.quote: The Fund will provide grants up to a maximum of $25,000 per project.

reporting.quote: Yes, this is a requirement of all the projects which the Fund supports, and is done through the website every six months.

eligibility.quote: Please note that applications with clearly incorrect conservation status and no justification will NOT be considered for funding.
will consider applications for an ex situ project where it is demonstrated to be critical to the survival of the species concerned.

The Fund is happy to provide continuation support for a project which had previously been supported, which is now completed and for which the Fund has received all required reporting by the time of the respective submission deadline.
Applications must be submitted in English with budgets and all financial data submitted in US Dollars.

after_award.quote: Yes, this is a requirement of all the projects which the Fund supports, and is done through the website every six months.

documents.quote: A short biography / curriculum vitae of the project applicant and a list of his / her relevant scientific and popular publications
A recent Annual Report or other description of your organization (e.g. strategic plan), if applicable
Please provide one JPEG image of the project's target species.
